title: Agent-Based Model Framework for the North Carolina Modeling Infectious Diseases Program (NC MInD ABM) Overview, Design Concepts, and Details Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2202.06853v2 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To help facilitate a variety of simulations related to healthcare facilities in North Carolina, we have developed an agent-based model (ABM) to accurately simulate patient (i.e., agent) movement to and from these facilities. This is an Overview, Design Concepts, and Details (ODD) Protocol, a standardized method for describing ABMs. This ODD provides detailed information on healthcare facilities in North Carolina, the agent movement to and between them, and any decisions that were made during the creation of this model. This ABM is intended to be used alongside disease-specific submodels. It can be used for purposes such as simulating the success of interventions on reducing disease transmission, simulating strain on facility resources (including staff and materials), and forecasting hospital capacity. Disease-specific ODDs should accompany this document. No details related to any submodels that use this ABM as a base model are included

translated_title: 北卡罗来纳州传染病建模项目的基于主体模型框架（NC MInD ABM）——概述、设计概念与细节（ODD）协议
translated_abstract: 为了帮助促进与北卡罗来纳州医疗机构相关的多种模拟，我们开发了一个基于主体模型（ABM），以准确模拟患者（即主体）往返于这些医疗机构的移动。本文采用概述、设计概念与细节（ODD）协议——这是一种描述ABM的标准化方法。本ODD提供了关于北卡罗来纳州医疗机构、主体往返及在机构之间的移动、以及模型创建过程中所做决策的详细信息。该ABM旨在与特定疾病的子模型配合使用，可用于多种目的，例如模拟干预措施在减少疾病传播方面的效果、模拟医疗机构资源（包括人员和物资）的压力，以及预测医院容量。特定疾病的ODD文档应与本文档配套使用。本文档不包含任何以该ABM为基础模型的子模型的相关细节。
tldr: 该论文提出了北卡罗来纳州传染病建模项目的基于主体模型（ABM）框架，通过标准化的ODD协议详细描述了患者往返医疗机构的移动模拟，可与疾病特异性子模型配合使用，用于评估干预措施效果、模拟医疗资源压力和预测医院容量。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an agent-based model (ABM) framework for the North Carolina Modeling Infectious Diseases Program, documented through a standardized ODD protocol, which simulates patient movement to and from healthcare facilities and can be paired with disease-specific submodels to evaluate interventions, assess facility resource strain, and forecast hospital capacity.
